story.headline: A Saudi business delegation led by Prince Mansour bin Muhammad Al-Saud, chairman of the Saudi chapter of the Saudi-Pakistani Joint Business Council, visited Karachi Port Trust on Monday and showed interest in investing in Karachi port infrastructure, logistics connectivity and green initiatives.
